title: SimFusion: Multi-Fidelity Simulation-based Testing of Automated Driving Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.34202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulation is the primary means of validating automated driving systems (ADS). Testing typically relies on a single simulator, forcing a trade-off between the speed of low-fidelity (LoFi) simulation and the realism of computationally expensive high-fidelity (HiFi) simulation. We present SimFusion, a multi-fidelity search-based testing framework that decides, for every candidate scenario, which simulator should execute it. Rather than approximating the ADS or its fitness, SimFusion learns whether LoFi and HiFi simulators are likely to agree on a scenario's outcome: scenarios predicted to agree run in the fast LoFi simulator, while all others are conservatively run in HiFi. We evaluate SimFusion on two ADS stacks, three driving scenarios, and four simulators, against LoFi-only, HiFi-only, and surrogate-assisted testing. translated_title: SimFusion：基于多保真度仿真的自动驾驶系统测试
translated_abstract: 仿真是验证自动驾驶系统（ADS）的主要手段。测试通常依赖于单一仿真器，这迫使人们需要在低保真度（LoFi）仿真的速度与计算开销高昂的高保真度（HiFi）仿真的真实性之间做出权衡。我们提出了SimFusion，这是一个多保真度、基于搜索的测试框架，它可以为每个候选场景决定应由哪个仿真器来执行。SimFusion并不去近似ADS本身或其适应度，而是学习LoFi与HiFi仿真器在场景结果上是否可能达成一致：预测会达成一致的场景在快速的LoFi仿真器中运行，而所有其他场景则保守地在HiFi仿真器中运行。我们在两个ADS技术栈、三个驾驶场景和四个仿真器上对SimFusion进行了评估，并与仅使用LoFi、仅使用HiFi以及代理辅助的测试方法进行了比较。在每种配置运行六次的情况下，SimFusion平均比仅使用HiFi的测试多发现2.1倍经HiFi验证的故障。
tldr: SimFusion提出了一种多保真度搜索测试框架，通过学习LoFi与HiFi仿真器对场景结果的判断是否一致来智能分配执行仿真器，从而在保证结果可靠性的前提下显著提升了自动驾驶系统测试的效率与故障发现能力。
en_tdlr: SimFusion is a multi-fidelity search-based testing framework that learns whether LoFi and HiFi simulators are likely to agree on a scenario's outcome, routing each scenario to the appropriate simulator and finding 2.1x more HiFi-validated failures than HiFi-only testing.
